uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hook.text: This worm grows up inside two animals: a dog... and a mosquito.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:biscuit.text: This is Biscuit. He's a dog, napping in the sun.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:poppy.text: This is Poppy. She's a mosquito. Only females bite. They need blood for their eggs.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:dilly.text: And Poppy is carrying someone. This is Dilly. She's a heartworm.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:past.text: Dilly began as a baby worm in another dog's blood. Poppy sipped her up.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grow.text: Inside Poppy, she grew for two weeks, then crawled down to her mouthparts.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:drop.text: Poppy doesn't inject her. Dilly spills onto the skin in a tiny drop... and wriggles in through the bite.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:walk.text: Under the skin, she molts, then travels for about two months. Slowly. Quietly.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:ride.text: One last molt, and she slips into a blood vessel. The blood carries her to the heart.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:turn.text: But the heart is just a stop on the way.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:home.text: Dilly settles in the arteries of the lungs, right next door.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:long.text: Here, she grows to her full size: up to thirty centimetres long.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:male.text: She isn't alone. A male has made it here too.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:babies.text: Months later, Dilly has babies. Tiny worms, drifting in Biscuit's blood.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:need.text: But they can't grow up inside Biscuit. They need a mosquito.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:again.text: So they wait... until a mosquito comes for a sip. And the journey begins again.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:button.text: A dog. A mosquito. And a worm that lives in both.
